AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
December 12, 2012
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit No. UP-2012-07 Applicant: Sprint.
Location: 791 S. Azusa Avenue
Use Permit No.UP-2012-07 request to allow Sprint to modify an existing legal-nonconforming telecommunications facility by adding two new parabolic backhaul antennas and replacing three (3) four foot panel antennas with three (3) six foot panel antennas on the existing antenna array located at 791 S. Azusa Avenue ("Public Storage" property).
Item F-1 Staff Report and Attachments
2.
Design Review No. DR-2012-26 & Variance No. V-2012-02 Applicant: Shea Homes
Location: Rosedale Tract: 66141 (Great park 1)
Assessor Parcel Numbers: 8625-035-007/008/006/005/004/003/002 & 001
Request for approval of a Design Review application requesting approval of the architectural design, layout and construction of 112 Multi-family units consisting of (7) 4-plex buildings and (21) 6-plex buildings located within the Promenade District of the Rosedale planned community. A Variance is requested as a part of this approval to allow reduced landscape planter dimensions and to allow reduced HOA landscape planting space from the required widths.
Item F-2 Staff Report and Attachments
3.
Appeal of Zoning Administrator's Denial of Minor Use Permit MUP 2012-14 Applicant: Tom Vafamanesh, Cities Auto Center
Location: 461 E. Arrow Highway
An appeal of the Zoning Administrator's denial of Minor Use Permit MUP 2012-14 which was a request to allow an auto and vehicle sales use to be located on a single parcel with multiple uses. The project site is located within the CAH (Arrow Highway Corridor) zone. The proposed use is allowed in the CAH zone with approval of a Minor Use Permit.
